decisions: Keep the existing monochrome editorial identity with violet as a selective accent, not the default hover color.
Use the established translucent glass material for toolkit and biography, with hand-drawn marker strokes only on requested copy.
Use black name-to-role reveal, monochrome inversions, underlines, arrow movement and rotation for varied feedback.
Experience uses accessible button disclosures with reversible CSS grid expansion; preserve the rotating border and SVG plus without clipping.
Creation dialog artwork and demo recordings are copied from the original Framer portfolio; JobHub remains unchanged.
Place the original Framer client-request workflow before the Projects counters; preserve its phase engine while using compact editorial cards and measured responsive connections.
